# Outline Panel

⌘⇧O: a label for every prompt, to see the shape of the work and jump back to any step.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

An entry and the outline button answer the pointer.

## Entries

One entry per prompt, under a heading for each day: the time on a small plate, then three to five words for what you asked. A short prompt is shown as it is. A long one is labeled by the agent’s small model, Haiku for Claude Code and Codex’s light model for Codex, in a session of its own, so nothing enters yours. Labels are asked for the entries in view, a few at a time, and kept for good, so each prompt is asked about once.

## Going back

Click an entry and the chat glides to that round. As you scroll, the entry in view wears the accent, so the outline always says where you are. The panel shares the left side with the [files](../docs/files.llms.md): one shows at a time, and one takes the other’s place without moving the chat.
